## 📝 Summary
Conducts release steps required for releasing stable tagged version 1.0.0.

Testing conducted as per: [Release Management](https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/blob/main/docs/docs/development/release-management.md)

- [x] Bump Version
- [x] Update python dependencies
- [x] Update Rust, Go, JS dependencies
- [x] Pass quality gates (linting)
- [x] Pass test gates (testing)
- [x] Build verification
- [x] SSO Verification
- [x] Security analysis
- [x] Deployment verification
- [x] Documentation verification
- [x] Plugin verification
- [x] Database migration testing
- [x] Manual Testing

---

## 🏷️ Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature / Enhancement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [x] Chore (deps, CI, tooling)
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## 🧪 Verification

| Check                     | Command         | Status |
|---------------------------|-----------------|--------|
| Lint suite                | `make lint`     |        |
| Unit tests                | `make test`     |        |
| Coverage ≥ 80%            | `make coverage` |        |

---

## ✅ Checklist
- [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for changes
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
- [x] No secrets or credentials committed

---

_Screenshots, design decisions, or additional context._
